text: When the quality-analyzer batch has 1000+ files and 50+ rule groups, process groups first with a scripted pass (drop style groups, keep metric candidates, apply rule heuristics) then target the manual pass on the top-10 highest-CCN files and non-grouped candidates with rules B006/W0102/W0715/B023 — these are the rules most likely to be missed by the script.

W0715 'Exception arguments suggest string formatting might be intended' is a high-value rule for Nova: the codebase uses NovaException.__init__(message=None, **kwargs) which only accepts one positional arg, so raise SomeNovaException('msg %s', value) will TypeError at call time — always keep W0715 in KEEP_RULES for non-grouped candidates.
Quality reviewer enforces a hard 25-finding-per-file cap: when filing violations, priority order is high→medium→low, then metric (lizard) before tool within each tier, then ascending line number.
TRY002 (raise-vanilla-exception) is always a duplicate of W0719 at the same line — drop TRY002, keep W0719 at medium severity.
